## What I did (all in the private repo, pushed)

Recommendation: **Drift Watch**, an independent public weekly record of how deployed frontier models' safety-relevant behaviour changes over time. It's cheap, fits the team, every month produces a publishable artefact, and it complements the incident-reporting regime being debated right now. I've been explicit about where I'm guessing — the first two weeks are a landscape check to confirm nobody already does this. Backup project included.

- **Daily 08:00 triage schedule** — read-only: summarises mail, saves drafts, pings you on deadlines/scams. Cannot pay, send, post, or publish.

Spend anything, send any email, sign anything, publish the site, change repo visibility, or read your personal mail/documents (medical, family, bank, passwords, tax, journal) beyond subject lines.

**Nothing further is pending on my side** — every remaining action depends on one of your decisions above. The fastest unblock is a one-word reply: "renew".
